  1. solvers.dataStructures

Uses of Package
solvers.dataStructures

Packages that use solvers.dataStructures
Package
Description
solvers
Solution algorithms of JMVA.
solvers.basis
Basis representations of the MoM and CoMoM exact solution algorithms of JMVA.
solvers.basis.comparators
Comparators used to order the basis vectors of the MoM and CoMoM algorithms.
solvers.control
Control logic of the JMVA solvers.
solvers.dataStructures
Data structures shared by the JMVA solvers (tuples, positions, lists and matrices).
solvers.linearSystem
Linear system formulation shared by the MoM and CoMoM exact algorithms of JMVA.
solvers.linearSystem.btf
Block Triangular Form (BTF) of the linear systems arising in the MoM and CoMoM algorithms, as described in the method of moments literature.
solvers.linearSystem.btf.macroBlocks
Macro blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.
solvers.linearSystem.btf.microBlocks
Micro blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.
solvers.linearSystem.btf.topLevelBlocks
Top level blocks of the Block Triangular Form linear system decomposition used by the JMVA MoM and CoMoM solvers.
solvers.linearSystem.simple
Simple linear system solvers used by JMVA.
solvers.linearSystem.simple.matrix
Matrix implementation of the simple linear system solvers used by JMVA.
solvers.linearSystemSolver
Linear system solver used by the exact JMVA solution algorithms.
solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms
Multiclass solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, RECAL, MoM, CoMoM, TreeMVA and TreeConvolution for closed multiclass models, together with their approximate variants.
solvers.queueingnet
Queueing network model of JMVA: stations, classes, service demands and visits used by the exact and approximate solution algorithms.
solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic
Monte Carlo logistic regression used by the exact JMVA algorithms when the model dimension grows (logistic approximation of normalizing constants).
solvers.queueingnet.montecarloLogistic.solver
Monte Carlo logistic solvers of JMVA.
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms
Tree based exact algorithms of JMVA: TreeMVA and TreeConvolution, which reduce the complexity of the exact solution of large closed models.
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.tmva
TreeMVA algorithm of JMVA, the tree based version of the exact Mean Value Analysis.
solvers.queueingnet.treeAlgorithms.treeConvolution
TreeConvolution algorithm of JMVA, the tree based version of the convolution algorithm.
solvers.utilities
Utilities of the JMVA solvers, such as the processing capacity checker used to verify that the workload can be processed by the network.
